Name: Stardew Dependency Checker
Author: 666bloodynex666
Description:
[b][Description][/b]
A command-line tool that lets you specify a mod and lists any mods you have installed that depend on it.

[b][Install][/b]
Requires Python 3+ ([url=https://www.python.org/downloads/]https://www.python.org/downloads/[/url])

You can place the script anywhere, but it will detect the Mods folder automatically if it's in the Stardew Valley install folder or the Mods folder itself.

[b][Usage][/b]
[code]﻿python stardew_dep_checker.py
[/code]Will prompt you for a mod specifier after you run it. If you want to specify the mod, use:
[code]python stardew_dep_checker.py "mod specifier"
[/code]Mod specifiers can be mod names, UniqueIDs, folder names, or manifest.json paths. Folder names must be the folder in a mod that contains the manifest.json file, which isn't always the root directory of the mod. For example, if you were trying to specify Stardew Valley Expanded using folder names you would have to use "Stardew Valley Expanded/Stardew Valley Expanded" because it places its core mod alongside its content pack mods.

If the script is outside the your Stardew Valley install and Mods folders, it may prompt you for a path first. Either your install folder or your Mods folder will work.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it contains files, but none of them are manifest.json.
